255: async fn cast_send_zk<P: Provider<T, AnyNetwork>, T: Transport + Clone, S: Signer>(
256:     provider: P,
257:     tx: WithOtherFields<TransactionRequest>,
258:     paymaster_params: Option<PaymasterParams>,
259:     signer: S,
260:     cast_async: bool,
261:     confs: u64,
262:     timeout: u64,
263:     to_json: bool,
264: ) -> Result<()> {
265:     // Build EIP712 transaction for ZKSync
266:     let tx = foundry_zksync_core::new_eip712_transaction(
267:         tx,
268:         Vec::new(), // Empty factory_deps
269:         paymaster_params,
270:         &provider,
271:         signer,
272:     )
273:     .await
274:     .map_err(|e| eyre::eyre!("Failed to create EIP712 transaction: {}", e))?;
275: 
276:     // Use send_raw_transaction for ZKSync
277:     let tx_hash = provider.send_raw_transaction(&tx).await?.tx_hash().to_owned();
278:     let cast = Cast::new(provider);
279:     handle_transaction_result(&cast, &tx_hash, cast_async, confs, timeout, to_json).await
280: }
